prompt: Create ONE original finished raster cursor concept based on the reference's quiet dark-fantasy materials, real dimensional shading, restrained ivory/steel edge light and deep soft shadow. The reference is only for material and lighting, REMOVE its sword, slash arc and scene entirely. Render the specified small tangible object, not a flat logo, outline glyph, SVG drawing or diagram. Diagonal orientation: precise sharp working tip at upper left, body extends to lower right. Strong asymmetric readable silhouette suitable for a 40px mouse cursor. Occupy about 75% of the square canvas with clear margin; isolated on completely uniform dark neutral grey background, no cast shadow on background, no gradients or scenery. No text, labels, borders, glitter, dramatic glow, gold or pervasive gritty stone texture. Keep substantial readable forms rather than tiny filigree. Object: one narrow triangular shard of old smoky blue stained glass, very sharp point upper-left, thicker irregular base lower-right. A slim dark lead came wraps two edges; a broad translucent glass face has subtle desaturated teal depth and one pale cold transmitted edge highlight. One simple internal lead division, tiny muted red glass fragment near the base. Physical transparent glass and lead, not a glowing crystal, not an icon etched on stone.
